title: The Northern road out of the county
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：northern　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 northern 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the musician wrote of ① a northern road out of the county in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so northern that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the northern ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the northern road out of the county that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too northern to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the northern ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a northern wind from the hills, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as northern as the wind from the hills they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was northern or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something northern, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite northern; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the northern ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, twice over, she wrote of another northern road out of the county in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less northern than anybody had expected. ⑩ The northern wind from the hills that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the northern ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 北部（前置定语 a northern road out of the county：1978 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件北部的北路）
B. adj. 北部／北方（两处加强说法：so northern that … 与 no less northern than …）
C. adj. 北部／北方（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 北部（表语 too northern to do：母亲觉得它太北部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 北方（前置定语 a northern wind from the hills：叔叔把整件事称作一桩北方的风）
F. adj. 北方（同级比较 as northern as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩北面山里吹来的风相比）
G. adj. 北方（后置定语 something northern：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 北方（受程度副词修饰 quite northern：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a northern road out of the county
the northern road out of the county that
a northern wind from the hills
The northern wind from the hills that

answers.why: northern 意为“北部”，1978 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件北部的北路”，此处作前置定语 a northern road out of the county。
northern 意为“北部”，此处用 so northern that 结构，说它北部到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
northern 意为“北部”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的北部出县的北路，等于最高级的说法。
northern 意为“北部”，母亲认为这件东西“太北部了，谁也用不上”，too northern to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
northern 意为“北方”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩北方的风”，此处作前置定语 a northern wind from the hills。
northern 意为“北方”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩北面山里吹来的风一样北方”，同级比较用 as northern as。
northern 意为“北方”，节目单上那半行字要的是“北方的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something northern。
northern 意为“北方”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当北方”，quite 修饰原级 northern。
northern 意为“北方”，no less northern than 表示“其北方不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之北方不亚于任何人的预料。
northern 意为“北方”，母亲 1990 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的北方风”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件北部的北路。（a northern road out of the county）
它北部到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so northern that …）
母亲觉得它太北部，谁也用不上。（too northern to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩北方的风。（a northern wind from the hills）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩北面山里吹来的风一样北方。（as northern as …）
到了 1985 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件北方的东西。（something northern）
answers: In 1978 the musician wrote of a northern road out of the county in the programme.
It was so northern that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too northern to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a northern wind from the hills.
He said nobody would call it as northern as the wind from the hills they had once had.
By 1985 the programme asked for nothing but something northern.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 northern 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the musician wrote of a northern road out of the county in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the northern road out of the county that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too northern to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a northern wind from the hills, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite northern, and everybody laughed.
The northern ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
